entries.title: Psalms 66:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. A Song. A Psalm.>> Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!

entries.title: Psalms 66:2
segments: Sing out the honor of His name; Make His praise glorious.

entries.title: Psalms 66:3
segments: Say to God, "How awesome are Your works! Through the greatness of Your power Your enemies shall submit themselves to You.

entries.title: Psalms 66:4
segments: All the earth shall worship You And sing praises to You; They shall sing praises [to] Your name." Selah

entries.title: Psalms 66:5
segments: Come and see the works of God; [He is] awesome [in His] doing toward the sons of men.

entries.title: Psalms 66:6
segments: He turned the sea into dry [land]; They went through the river on foot. There we will rejoice in Him.

entries.title: Psalms 66:7
segments: He rules by His power forever; His eyes observe the nations; Do not let the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 66:8
segments: ¶Oh, bless our God, you peoples! And make the voice of His praise to be heard,

entries.title: Psalms 66:9
segments: Who keeps our soul among the living, And does not allow our feet to be moved.

entries.title: Psalms 66:10
segments: For You, O God, have tested us; You have refined us as silver is refined.

entries.title: Psalms 66:11
segments: You brought us into the net; You laid affliction on our backs.

entries.title: Psalms 66:12
segments: You have caused men to ride over our heads; We went through fire and through water; But You brought us out to rich [fulfillment].

entries.title: Psalms 66:13
segments: ¶I will go into Your house with burnt offerings; I will pay You my vows,

entries.title: Psalms 66:14
segments: Which my lips have uttered And my mouth has spoken when I was in trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 66:15
segments: I will offer You burnt sacrifices of fat animals, With the sweet aroma of rams; I will offer bulls with goats. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 66:16
segments: Come [and] hear, all you who fear God, And I will declare what He has done for my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 66:17
segments: I cried to Him with my mouth, And He was extolled with my tongue.

entries.title: Psalms 66:18
segments: If I regard iniquity in my heart, The Lord will not hear.

entries.title: Psalms 66:19
segments: [But] certainly God has heard [me]; He has attended to the voice of my prayer.

entries.title: Psalms 66:20
segments: Blessed [be] God, Who has not turned away my prayer, Nor His mercy from me!
